notes.title: 2.2 Update Notes
notes.content:
Add an option to simulate keyboard long presses
Add a setting for long press interval time

notes.title: Annual Version Update 2.0
notes.content:
Fix the mutual mapping between MIDI keyboard and Computer keyboard when in the main window
Fix failure to output when MIDI listening is not 0

Optimize MIDI key range to select any range of keys
OptimizeWhen in the settings interface, the mapping function will be locked
Optimize options for quickly locating lists by pressing the MIDI button

Add MIDI input device list display
Add Output Voice Selection
Add Memo Field
Add mapping type, now you can choose keyboard, mouse, or text
Add controller, bend tone, system additional message mapping
